Name: Bera
Summary: Bera was the king of Sodom who rebelled against Chedorlaomer and lost the battle in the Valley of Siddim.
KeyStory: Bera's defeat left Sodom plundered and Lot captured — until Abram rescued them and Bera offered Abram the recovered goods, which Abram refused.
LifeLesson: Empires rise and fall, but God's promise to Abram outlasted every king of his day.
